definitions.gloss: celebratory toast; victory drink; celebratory cup
definitions.explanation: A drink raised in celebration of an achievement, victory, or happy occasion. The act of drinking to celebrate.

examples.japanese: {祝杯|しゅくはい}を{挙|あ}げる。
examples.english: To raise a toast in celebration.

examples.japanese: {優勝|ゆうしょう}の{祝杯|しゅくはい}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: We raised a toast to the championship victory.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}り、チーム{全員|ぜんいん}で{祝杯|しゅくはい}を{挙|あ}げて{喜|よろこ}びを{分|わ}かち{合|あ}った。
examples.english: Years of effort paid off, and the whole team raised a toast and shared in the joy.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set expression {祝杯|しゅくはい}を{挙|あ}げる (to raise a celebratory toast). A somewhat formal and literary word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝杯|しゅくはい}を{挙|あ}げる (to raise a celebratory toast)
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}の{祝杯|しゅくはい} (a victory toast)

CONTRAST:
- {献杯|けんぱい}: a toast offered to the deceased — used at funerals and memorial services
- {乾杯|かんぱい}: cheers, toast — general, can be used at any occasion
